title: Compactly supported tests supported in the blown-up domain are integrable for the blow-up
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N, V an n-varifold on U, ξ ∈ ℝ^N, t > 0 and F ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) with ξ + t·y ∈ U for every (y, S) ∈ tsupport F. Then F is integrable with respect to V_{ξ,t} = rescaledMeasure V ξ t = ofReal(t^{-n})·(V.measure)_#[(z, S) ↦ (t^{-1}(z − ξ), S)].
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (ξ : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ) (F : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), 0 < t → (∀ z ∈ tsupport F, ξ + t • z.1 ∈ U) → Integrable (fun z ↦ F z) (rescaledMeasure V ξ t)
